resources.string: Visual picture checks and a separate phone-camera experiment. Use your TV’s own menu to make any adjustments.
Offline · No permissions · No automatic settings changes
This deletes only this app’s checklist and notes. It does not change or restore your TV settings.
Let the TV stabilise. Use your usual room lighting and an SDR picture preset. Note the original values before changing anything in the normal picture menu. Controls and their names vary by TV.
These checks apply to this app’s SDR picture path. HDMI, HDR, games and other presets need separate checks. This is a visual guide, not instrument-validated calibration.
Show the border and circle. If edges are missing or the circle is stretched, compare your TV’s normal picture-fit or overscan options. The whole frame should be visible and the circle round.

Compare the dark steps. Look for visible separation without making black look grey. Your TV’s black-level control may be called Brightness; Backlight or Panel light is a different setting. Do not copy a universal number.
Compare the near-white steps. If several merge, try reducing the ordinary contrast control and compare again. Code 255 is this app’s full-range white; 235 is not a universal white endpoint here.
Look at the black and white edges. Compare the normal sharpness control and watch for bright outlines or ringing. Android may scale this app’s surface: this is not proof of panel-level pixel mapping.
Use the grey ramp to compare your TV’s ordinary colour-temperature presets. There is no trusted white reference here, so this cannot identify D65 or certify the most accurate preset.
After the pattern, press Back and choose an outcome below to move to the next check.
These are your observations, not accuracy measurements. To undo picture changes, restore the original values in your TV’s own menu. Deleting this checklist cannot restore them.

1. Open the QR or link on your phone.

2. On this TV, show the fields and choose an ID with Left / Right.

3. On your phone, start the camera. Cover its sampling frame with the uniform TV patch and confirm the same ID/RGB before capturing.
QR code to open the TV Tune companion on your phone; the written link is also available.

The QR opens the page with the camera off. Match IDs manually: no automatic pairing. This checks capture quality, not colour accuracy. The report does not create a calibration profile or apply TV settings.
Left / Right: patch · OK: labels · Back: exit
OK: labels · Back: instructions, then choose an outcome to continue
Paused after inactivity. Press OK to resume.
Check that the TV is displaying SDR. Output processing has not been instrument-verified.
SYNTHETIC REFERENCE · not a measurement of this TV
IMPORTED SAMPLE · source and optical accuracy unverified
OK: toggle correction on the right · Back: exit
Only these app-owned patches. No TV settings, other apps or HDMI changes.
RGB-code balancing, not validated display calibration. Gains may clip highlights.
Preview sample refused. Use three finite neutral RGB codes within the documented limits. No picture settings were changed. Press Back.
